sources.name: Indian Nutrient Databank (Anuvaad Solutions, 2024)
sources.notes: INDB.xlsx downloaded directly from the authors' GitHub repo. 1,014 cooked recipes, per 100 g and per serving. Serving grams derived as per-serving kcal / per-100g kcal x 100.

sources.name: Indian Food Composition Tables 2017, ICMR-NIN (Longvah et al.)
sources.notes: Accessed via the @ifct2017/compositions npm mirror (542 foods) which reproduces IFCT 2017 values. Energy converted from kJ to kcal (/4.184). The NIN book itself is not open-download.

sources.name: Manufacturer product label / website
sources.notes: Only Nestle India (MAGGI) could be read from an official manufacturer page. Amul, Parle, Coca-Cola and Haldiram's official nutrition pages were not retrievable; those items are omitted rather than sourced from aggregators.

caveats: No value in this file was written from memory. Every kcal/macro traces to INDB or IFCT 2017.
INDB counts the FULL cooking/frying oil in a recipe, not the absorbed amount. Dishes above 400 kcal/100g were EXCLUDED, not shipped.
Many INDB serving sizes are whole-recipe yields (4-6 people). Servings implying >1200 kcal were dropped.
katori weights are ESTIMATED. The ICMR-NIN household-measures table is not open-access and could not be read.
Packaged foods (Maggi, Parle-G, Amul) are NOT included - no manufacturer label was read.
v2: deep-fried items are now INCLUDED with the raw INDB value, which OVER-counts oil. See each item's notes for the published absorbed-oil range. These are confidence:low - flag them in the app.
v2: where a row's fat value alone implied more energy than the row's total kcal, macros were set to null (kcal kept).
v2: katori and corrected serving weights remain ESTIMATES - the ICMR-NIN household-measures table is still not accessible.
